role: Research control-only integration baseline; not the default submission or original demo. It cannot open the progressive collision qualifier without an independently frozen, eligible research detector.
payload: Known mass in inclusive 2.86--8.00 kg and the unchanged calibrated bounds select one loaded policy; zero/other finite nonnegative masses choose exact R10. Unknown/nonfinite/negative inputs are errors. No gate based on fixture or case labels.
physics: R16 balanced C with scheduled pose-node reuse and causal staged normal equations; negative all-cycle timing studies are retained.
observer: Unchanged R14 coupled observer on supported torque; R10 otherwise. Known 16N failure is not claimed fixed.
checks: Three matched loaded normal closed loops with R16 D: active ec1:down, heavy active sh4, sh3 without height. Compare all detector samples, cost/FA/saturation, qpos, torque and force against previously declared R17A numerical equivalence tolerances, not exact equality. Exhaustive all-case hard timing and any new impacts not claimed.
